title: CL68 agents and their subagents: the overview
caption: Three children, in order: the prompts/ wrapper goes, specialists become subagents inside their agent, and minions become lookup agents beside them.

cards.title: CL68 Agents and their subagents
cards.text: Every prompt sits where the engine reads it, and each agent holds its own subagents.

cards.title: CL68.1 prompts/ goes
cards.text: Each project embeds its prompt folders from its root; the showroom names each business once.

cards.title: CL68.2 Subagents
cards.text: A specialist moves into its agent's subagents/ folder; its level comes from its header.

cards.title: CL68.3 Lookup agents
cards.text: A minion becomes a lookup agent, a subagent with one task and one tool.
